exposure: Umbilical artery peak systolic to end diastolic flow velocity ratio (S/D ratio)
cohort: 845 antenatal women who went into labor at the Fujian Provincial Maternity and Children’s Hospital from January 2016 to January 2017
finding: Multiparous status and longer umbilical cord length were highly associated with umbilical cord torsion, and the umbilical coiling index (UCI) was a better predictor of fetal distress than the umbilical artery S/D ratio.
